title: FlightAware Diversion Event Summary
app: FlightAware, OpenSky, MarineTraffic, ADS-B receivers, ABRP trip plans, toll-tag exports, and EV charging receipts forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flightaware:flight diverted="true"
| stats count as diversions by airline
| where diversions>0
| sort - diversions
description: Uses FlightAware diversion events telemetry to monitor which airlines in your log are seeing diversions in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for trip disruptions that deserve contingency planning, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest FlightAware diversion events data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which airlines in your log are seeing diversions so you can spot trip disruptions that deserve contingency planning before it becomes annoying.
